description: This PHP class 'LoggerSubscriber' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Subscriber' subscribes to Symfony kernel exception events and logs exception details using an injected logger service.

classes.name: LoggerSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class for handling Symfony kernel exception events and logging errors.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the kernel exception event with high priority.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exception events by retrieving the exception and logging its message and trace.
